key_insight: Jianmu-Q uses coordinated AI agents to convert natural-language quantum field theory descriptions into validated quantum simulation workflows spanning theory, discretization, qubit mapping, and circuit design.
engineering_relevance: The framework lowers the barrier between field-theory modeling and quantum hardware execution, offering a practical pipeline for end-to-end quantum simulation engineering.
method: Specialized agents separately perform theoretical formulation, lattice discretization, qubit mapping, and circuit synthesis.
Physical consistency checks and independent numerical calculations validate each stage of the workflow.
Selected circuits are run on IBM quantum hardware after noiseless simulation and cross-checks.
evidence_signal: Across three benchmark theories, noiseless circuit simulations converged toward independent exact-diagonalization and tensor-network results, with some circuits also demonstrated on IBM hardware.
watch_item: Because the workflow depends on multiple automated transformations and validation steps, correctness may still be sensitive to model errors, discretization choices, and hardware noise for larger systems.
paper_title: Jianmu-Q: Bridging Quantum Field Theory and Quantum Hardware with AI Agents
